stem.text: The equation for the reaction of aqueous thiosulfate ions, $\text{S}_2\text{O}_3^{2-}$, and aqueous dioxo-vanadium ions, $\text{VO}_2^{+}$, is shown.

C.text: $x$ and $z$ are the same value and half the value of $y$; from +5 to +4

D.text: $x$ and $z$ are the same value and half the value of $y$; from +4 to +5
